refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SilikoFunctionCallerInstallOperators` function installs the operators used by the infix parser to handle operators.
* `Caller` is the `SilikoFunctionCaller` object to install the functions into.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: `SilikoFunctionCallerInstallOperators` returns true if all functions were installed successfully, `NULL` otherwise. If `NULL` was returned, then the selection of functions installed in the `SilikoFunctionCaller` object is unspecified.
